name: Star Catch
description: A controlled browser game fixture where players move across the sky and catch falling stars.
about: Star Catch is a controlled browser game fixture used to exercise game recordings and telemetry. The player moves across a simple night sky while stars fall toward the ground. This fixture is part of Blaze and is supplied for development and acceptance testing. It is not a production game listing or evidence about another game.

The game is deliberately small so that recording, playback, and measurement workflows can be checked against a predictable scene. Players use the controls shown on the screen to move and catch the stars. Any data collected while using this fixture should be treated as test data.

session.saving: Optional telemetry is sent to the selected workspace

howToPlay: Move using the on-screen controls or keyboard.

faq.a: A controlled fixture for testing Blaze.
No, it is a local development fixture.
